svg.text: FIG-R8 · Measured vs designed — the honesty map, one row per sub-layer
Source: R6 Full-Stack Atlas v0-2 §7 (parsed verbatim) and §2.L3 narrative
keys come from a cloud host's OS CSPRNG, or from
no key in this programme has lived in hardware
radio is a free-space model; time is the host clock
— (PC5 mode-4 ResourcePool is I; no row)
no PHY/MAC result; RF linkability is Dv only (PF-44c)
state is counted, never proved; the changed walk is intact
revocation lists are a Python dict or file
automine as the condition of every M1 row
no consensus protocol has been measured; N_v = 1
gas is exact; price is E (#20)
capacity at design G and Δ (PF-49)
ecrecover and bn256 carry the load
per-function gas and attack cells for ten columns
117 SCF rows; negative tests for 24 of 44 checked rows
chain id binds the outer tx only
did:ethr and did:mobi are real; the rest are synthesised
VC v2.0 Data Integrity, thesis cryptosuite (#4,
IDTX exists as code without a result (I)
message freshness and verifier v3 (#44–#48); state
JSON-signed messages; staleness bounded in messages, not time
mobility is mocked in the runs of record
Teal I marker = the row names an item at status I (implemented, unmeasured: code runs, no register row) — L0.1 ResourcePool, LH.3 OBU object, L5.2 IdtxExecutor/CEI check, L6.3 IDTX.
Red outline = consensus / finality / availability / persistence sub-layers: nothing above an automining single process has been executed. R6 §2.L3: "The repository's executed agreement mechanism
is Hardhat automine ... provides ordering trivially and safety and liveness not at all"; Besu, QBFT, Gasper, RocksDB, node permissioning are DESIGN.
Source: R6 Full-Stack Atlas v0-2 §7 table, locked by R9 SLD-12 (cell text verbatim, markdown stripped). Scale R9 PN-32 · make_phase2_figures_v0-2.py (v0-2 inputs).
